messages:
Alex (SRE): Following up on the embeddings-index lag postmortem 11 We identified recurring slowdowns during bulk ingest windows. Need clear owners for action items + verification plan. Can folks claim by EOD Tue?
Mei (PM): I'll coordinate prioritization with product and own the project ticket. assigning INC-17550-EPIC. Will create sub-tickets for each action.
Jorge (Infra): I can take the autoscale + kube resource tuning task. Opening JIRA-4210. Will document current HPA settings and a proposed CPU/memory curve.
Lina (Support): I'll own customer comms and acceptance criteria for "index freshness" SLA. JIRA-4211. Need sample customer queries to validate.
Alex (SRE): I'll own the ingestion pipeline refactor (backpressure + batching). JIRA-4212. I'll also add a bench that reproduces 10k-doc bursts.
Mei (PM): Proposed RACI:
```
R: Alex (ingest refactor), Jorge (infra changes)
A: Mei (product sign-off)
C: Lina, app-product
I: eng-oncall, analytics
```
Jorge (Infra): +1. For infra I'll add a canary plan: alter resource limits in canary namespace, monitor pod restart rate + queue depth.
Alex (SRE): Repro snippet: `python tests/simulate_ingest.py --docs 10000 --concurrency 50 --rate 1000`
remediation-bot: Created checklist: JIRA-4210, JIRA-4211, JIRA-4212. Default due-date: 2025-04-18. Use `/remediate extend <ticket>` to change due dates.
Lina (Support): For customer validation: can someone drop an anonymized example payload? I can craft acceptance tests around it.
Alex (SRE): Dropping sample (sanitized): `s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1755000000/sample-payload.json`
Mei (PM): Let's set verification owners: Lina = customer acceptance + SLA test, Alex = unit/regression bench, Jorge = infra health and canary. Target dates: Alex 2025-04-10, Jorge 2025-04-14, Lina 2025-04-16.
Jorge (Infra): Canary plan: dev -> canary (5%) -> limited prod (20%) -> prod. Metrics to watch: pod CPU, queue depth, p95 indexing delay. Will post YAML diff.
Alex (SRE): I'll add a synthetic to the CI pipeline that runs nightly for 2 weeks post-rollout. Also adding alert: indexing-delay > 30s for 5m.
Lina (Support): I'll prepare templated comms for customers affected and a short triage doc for support.
Mei (PM): Weekly follow-ups for 4 weeks? Suggest Tue 9am, starting 2025-04-08. I will schedule recurring meeting and add notes to the postmortem doc.
remediation-bot: Reminder created: weekly-followup (4 occurrences) starting 2025-04-08.
Alex (SRE): Acceptance criteria on JIRA-4212: reproducible under lab load, <10s median indexing, p95 < 30s, no >1% increase in pod restarts during canary.
Jorge (Infra): Will include rollback steps and a brief runbook snippet for oncall: `kubectl scale deployment ingest --replicas=<n>` and `kubectl apply -f rollback/`.
Mei (PM): Action: I'll ensure each JIRA has labels: `postmortem-action`, `recurrence`, `ingest-pipeline`. Also assign story points and link to INC-17550-EPIC.
Lina (Support): ACK. I'll also add a verification checklist to JIRA-4211 for customer-facing tests.
Alex (SRE): Pairing offer: happy to pair with Jorge during the canary cutover.
Mei (PM): Thanks. Summary: Owners set -> Alex JIRA-4212 (ingest refactor) due 2025-04-10, Jorge JIRA-4210 (infra tuning + canary) due 2025-04-14, Lina JIRA-4211 (support + SLA tests) due 2025-04-16. Weekly sync scheduled. If anyone needs to shift dates, ping me. :thumbsup:
Jorge (Infra): ACK :white_check_mark:
Lina (Support): ACK :eyes:
Alex (SRE): ACK :rocket:
remediation-bot: Thread locked for new owners after EOD 2025-04-01 to keep assignments stable.
